Service Name Eth If_ Check Wakeup Syntax Std_ Return Type Eth If_ Check Wakeup ( Ecu M_ Wakeup Source Type Wakeup Source ) Service ID [hex] 0x30 Sync/ Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Wakeup Source Source device which initiated the wake up event. The source device could either be a Ethernet switch or a Ethernet transceiver Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK when the re quest to check for a wake - up of the affected Ethernet hardware (e.g. PHY) has been accepted. E_ NOT_ OK when the request to check for a wake - up of the affected Ethernet hardware is rejected. Description This API request the affected Ethernet hardware to c heck for a signaled wake - up. The used Ethernet hardware could be an Ethernet switch or Ethernet transceiver (PHY). This is used e.g. for Ethernet hardware which is compliant to the specification of Open Alliance TC10. This API is called by the integration code. The function could be called in context of the interrupt or on task level. Available via Eth If.h
